notes.title: Huge update turns Steam sandbox game into a mix of Roadcraft and State of Decay
notes.notes:
Sandbox games live and die by how much stuff you can do. They can be lean or expansive, massive or tight, but each must offer multiple approaches to the open word and its challenges. Games like Roadcraft and State of Decay manage this well, though they represent opposite ends of the sandbox spectrum. A vehicle-based survival game called The Front just got a huge update, which allows players to customize vehicles, opening up almost endless possibilities.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The Front Major Update Now Live — Vehicle Assembly Gameplay Trailer Released
notes.notes: [p]At 8:00 UTC on July 14, The Front officially launched a major update! The core feature of this update is the introduction of the Vehicle Assembly system, allowing players to freely build and customize combat vehicles to create highly personalized war machines that can adapt flexibly to different battlefield environments and enemies. At the same time, we’ve released a brand-new gameplay trailer that fully showcases the entire experience from assembly to combat. We invite everyone to watch, like, and share it with your friends![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/ZxsJ92De7gQ"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Currently, [i]The Front[/i] is still in Early Access. We aim to continuously expand the game’s building boundaries and tactical possibilities through deeper and more flexible system gameplay.[/p][p] [/p][p]At the same time, to celebrate this update, we’re launching a limited-time [b]20% discount from July 14 to July 28[/b]. We invite everyone to seize this opportunity and join the world of [i]The Front[/i]![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/1a282560320f22088beff83ca39f81806377f4d7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Vehicle Assembly System Live — Build Freely, Fight Anytime[/b][/h3][p]In this update, the highly anticipated Vehicle Assembly system makes its official debut, showcased in detail through a live gameplay trailer. Players can freely combine chassis, engines, weapons, armor modules, and more on the Assembly Platform to build uniquely styled and highly functional custom war machines.[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/23dc85bc91a1523834a66cce0166b206c520edde.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once assembled, vehicles can be deployed immediately. The effects of different parts on core attributes like speed, firepower, and defense are highly intuitive. Even small adjustments can lead to vastly different combat experiences. Currently, the system offers over 40 available parts, all obtainable through exploration and combat.[/p][p] [/p][p]To ensure gameplay balance, we’ve incorporated restrictions such as weight capacity, power consumption, and mounting points into the system. These encourage players to make strategic trade-offs during assembly, preventing imbalanced setups caused by excessive stacking.[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/00171fad0c794bdba39e5bbbe8528ce9789eb675.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]Black Sun Obelisks Unlocked [/b][/h3][p]We’ve also added brand-new dungeon content in this update — seven “Black Sun Obelisk” exploration zones are now open. Each zone features unique terrain layouts and exclusive boss mechanics, with overall difficulty designed for the late-game stage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/2e63fbdc1429d4768156ed6ab9f547f182e6bb8d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The newly introduced “Vehicle Monsters” serve as a special enemy type, providing a real combat testing ground for players’ custom-built war machines, and further strengthening the synergy between vehicle construction and combat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/c7ab03f588de724e858846c0a7eaed70b25ebe32.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, dungeon challenge drops and progression pacing have been redesigned to create a closed-loop cycle of “challenge dungeons → obtain materials → assemble war machines → advance progression,” adding more depth and a greater sense of accomplishment to the overall gameplay flow.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Worldbuilding Progresses, Core Experience Refined[/b][/h3][p]The lore surrounding the “Black Sun Project” has been further expanded in this update. Players will gradually uncover the secrets of the Empire’s Ether experiments through exploring zones, unlocking keys, and gathering data. Although the main storyline is still in its early stages, the core narrative framework is taking shape, and we plan to continue expanding key story elements in future updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/a850be92426f480ddc337399bb2751d441945c0e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]At the same time, we have optimized multiple core systems, including complex terrain loading, AI behavior logic, character model performance, and UI interactions. While these improvements are not the main highlights of this update, we believe they bring significant value in enhancing overall smoothness and user experience.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]Expanding the Depth of Building × Combat Around the Assembly Core[/b][/h3][p]We plan to continue expanding the core gameplay of “Vehicle Assembly” in upcoming updates. Currently in development are flying vehicles, spider-claw war machines, and a customization paint system. Our goal is to gradually shape “free assembly + strategic combat” into the main gameplay path of [i]The Front[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]We welcome everyone to join the world of [i]The Front[/i] and experience the fun of free assembly. Thank you all for your continued attention and support — we will keep refining the content and bringing new surprises![/p]

notes.title: The Front – July Major Update Preview: Build and Customize Your Vehicles!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Rebels![/p][p]First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt thanks to every one of you fighting alongside us in this world. Whether you’ve been here since the earliest test days or just joined our ranks recently, you’re the driving force that keeps us pushing forward and improving. Your feedback, suggestions, and patient support mean the world to us — and we never take it for granted.[/p][p] [/p][p]Today, we’re thrilled to share some exciting news — [b]The Front[/b] will receive a [b]massive free update this July![/b] This update will roll out in Standard Mode, introducing the brand-new [b]Vehicle Assembly[/b] core feature, seven new [b]Black Sun Obelisks[/b] to explore, and a host of improvements focused on performance, onboarding, gameplay flow, and overall controls.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/dc6e233b8d0bad8a4f5662977d8fe7f3abb49d8a.jpg"][/img]Some of these additions have been in the works for a long time, while others come directly from your suggestions and wishes. We’re deeply grateful for your patience and for walking this still-evolving road with us. We hope this update marks a brand-new starting point for The Front to keep moving forward — and to become even better, together with you.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Vehicle Assembly Arrives — Build Freely, Define Your Own Way to Fight[/b][/h2][p]In this post-apocalyptic world, vehicles shouldn’t all look the same — and they shouldn’t be limited to what the system dictates.[/p][p] [/p][p]In the new update, [b]Vehicle Assembly[/b] will make its official debut. It’s not just a simple feature — it’s a complete system built around freedom of construction, performance trade-offs, and expanded combat possibilities. Our hope is that you’ll truly start from scratch and craft your very own apocalypse war machine with your own hands.[/p][p] [/p][p]To support this, we’ve added a dedicated workbench called the [b]Vehicle Modification Platform[/b]. Here, you can build and customize your vehicles. The platform requires connection to the power grid and a stable power supply to operate, following the same logic as other electrical devices.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/cb41573e3c9deb400eba5d7c54b211b5fd210293.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]1.Vehicle Composition and Component Types[/b][/h3][p]In the assembly system, a complete vehicle consists of three main structural components：[/p][list][*][p]Basic Structure[b]:[/b] Composed of the chassis, frame, and engine — all three are essential, determining the vehicle’s overall framework and performance limits[/p][/*][*][p]Mountable Modules[b]:[/b] Including weapons, armor, and support components, used to enhance offense, defense, and tactical capabilities[/p][/*][*][p]Exterior Paint: Will eventually support customizations like painting and graffiti (not yet implemented in this update)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]This update will introduce over [b]40 buildable parts[/b] in the initial release, covering the following:[/p][list][*][p]Chassis[b]:[/b] The load-bearing skeleton. Differences between wheeled and tracked types affect mobility and overall size[/p][/*][*][p]Frame: Determines the overall vehicle frame and mounting expansion capabilities[/p][/*][*][p]Engine: Provides power and electricity output — the “heart” of the vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons: Various types of firepower systems that can be mounted for offensive output[/p][/*][*][p]Armor: Enhances the vehicle’s overall defense, boosting battlefield survivability[/p][/*][*][p]Utility: Includes Storage Chest, Gas Can, and Battery to enhance vehicle functionality and sustain combat endurance[/p][/*][/list][p]Vehicle parts come in different quality tiers and can be obtained by defeating vehicle NPCs or exploring areas like the [b]Black Sun Obelisk[/b]. All parts are assembled modularly, allowing you to build a war machine with controllable performance and a style that’s entirely your own.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/124c2638394e0ac0ecbe058baec8e1d30d5e27d7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]2.Assembly Rules and Mounting System[/b][/h3][p]Free assembly doesn’t mean no rules. To maintain construction logic and combat balance, vehicle assembly will follow these core mechanics:[/p][list][*][p]Basic Constraints: Includes weight capacity, total power, and part quantity limits[/p][/*][*][p]Mounting Point Compatibility System:[/p][/*][/list][p](1)    Mounting points on the frame and parts must match in shape and structure[/p][p](2)    Universal components (such as the frame and armor) can display varied appearances[/p][p](3)    Special components (such as engines, weapons, and utility modules) have no restrictions on installation locations[/p][p](4)    Parts that don’t match or exceed limits cannot be mounted, preventing misaligned assembly[/p][p] [/p][p]The entire assembly process unfolds in real time within the open world, with every step instantly reflected in the environment—letting you directly experience the satisfaction of building your vehicle from parts to a complete war machine.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]3.Vehicle Repair System[/b][/h3][p]When a vehicle is not completely destroyed, players can use the Vehicle Repair Station to fix it by consuming repair materials.
Additionally, removed components can be sent to their respective workbenches for individual repairs, reducing resource waste and extending the vehicle’s lifespan.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]4.Future Expansion Preview[/b][/h3][p]Future updates will introduce [b]Mechanical Claws[/b] and [b]Flying Vehicles[/b]. Additionally, [b]Vehicle Painting[/b] and [b]Graffiti Systems[/b] are already planned for development, allowing you to customize the appearance of metal parts—making your war machine not only practical but uniquely yours.[/p][p] [/p][p]We can’t wait to see the first battle vehicle you build that truly belongs to you.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Black Sun Obelisks Unveiled — Seven Strongholds + All-New Boss Challenges[/b][/h2][p]Exploration content is also getting a major expansion. This new update will add seven [b]Black Sun Obelisks[/b] — each a distinct fortress with unique environments, serving as milestone challenge points to test players’ skills.[/p][p] [/p][p]Boss challenges will range from the entry-level Forlorn Clown to the survival- and damage-testing Crazed Eye and Brianman. Each boss features unique skills and tactical mechanics.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additionally, monster distribution, loot rewards, and stronghold pacing have all been systematically optimized. We’ve also introduced a new enemy type — vehicle monsters — to put your war machine’s strength to the ultimate test.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/f67d2e1d9d46ad610a2b42a14d4b54040174240f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Lore Reforged — The Black Sun Project Emerges[/b][/h2][p]We’ve also taken this opportunity to review and expand the overall lore and background of The Front:[/p][list][*][p]How the Empire’s lust for the primordial energy “Ether” led it down the path of tyranny and destruction？[/p][/*][*][p]Why the launch of the “Black Sun Project” triggered the undead outbreak, plunging all of human civilization into the abyss？[/p][/*][*][p]How players, as members of the future resistance, travel through time to the eve of the launch？[/p][/*][/list][p]……[/p][p]These mysteries will be gradually unveiled in the new update. You will take on the role of a visitor from the apocalypse, steadily conquering the Black Sun Obelisks on[b] [/b]Heaven Isle,[b] [/b]unlocking seven key data fragments, and infiltrating the Black Sun Core within the Eagle’s Nest (coming soon) to stop the project from launching.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/cbbd0098e19fbcbbfd5e6a9d5b4faf801b55a3f5.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Multifaceted Improvements: Comprehensive Upgrades to Performance, AI, and Controls[/b][/h2][p]Beyond gameplay updates, this version also brings improvements across multiple dimensions：[/p][list][*][p]Art and underground scene performance optimizations to reduce lag and improve overall smoothness[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced AI behavior and NPC animations for more natural combat actions[/p][/*][*][p]Added new character creation models to expand customization options[/p][/*][*][p]Improved interaction details, such as box status indicators, death markers on the map, and cancelable progress bars[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]We see this update as a fresh starting point. Moving forward, we’ll continue adding new component types and explore gameplay directions like PvP vehicle battles. We know that only through constant iteration and listening to your feedback can this post-apocalyptic world become more vibrant—and a place you’ll want to stay in for the long haul.[/p][p] [/p][p]This July, we welcome you back to the world of The Front.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Update for The Front - Adventure Mode and More!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We're thrilled to announce a major update for The Front, introducing a brand-new mode and exciting features that will enhance your gameplay experience. 

Players can access it via Steam library - Right click The Front - Properties - Beta - Beta Participation - Alpha test new adventure mode test. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/a6970f58f1102d6630c778c8c259a9744208f48f.jpg[/img]

Then choose alphatest while launching the game via library:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/60531a880307cd68004f864fdcda967d2c549861.jpg[/img]

If you have discovered any new version related bugs, you can report it via our Discord server discord.gg/playthefront - Alphatest bugs Channel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/43a40d0dec464aa4d18f02cea9d9171b85585c7d.jpg[/img]


[h2]Introducing “Adventure Mode”[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/c45798126c2f07de08ef59446d069e26ae95b61c.jpg[/img]

Adventure Mode is a completely new experience, separate from our existing gameplay modes. It offers a fresh combat system, unique mission flow, and new ways to grow your character. You’ll notice significant changes in level design, boss monsters, and distinctive gameplay features.

In this mode, characters no longer have levels. The tech tree has been revamped, allowing you to unlock new technologies automatically as you complete missions and track down bosses. You can dive into this thrilling adventure with up to five friends by selecting Adventure Mode when creating or joining a server.

[h2]Key Differences from the Open World Mode[/h2]

[h3]- New Tutorial and Challenge Stages:[/h3]

We've introduced new tutorial stages to guide you through the basic game mechanics and combat techniques. The challenge stages, featuring complex environments and formidable bosses, are designed to enhance your combat experience. We’ve also optimized routes and added new structures like watchtowers and houses to enrich the scene effects.

[h3]- Enhanced Melee Combat:[/h3]

Prepare for a more diverse melee combat system! With new weapons like machetes, clubs, and hammers, you can now perform combos, charge attacks, block, and dodge. Consistent attacks on specific body parts of monsters can even lead to limb dismemberment, providing a hyper-realistic battle experience.

[h3]- Task-Based Technology Unlocking with Boss Tracking:[/h3]

In the "Spark" interface, you can now access detailed information on bosses. By activating the "Tracking Mode," you can quickly locate bosses using your portable radar. Defeating bosses, either solo or with your team, will earn you tracking rewards, including specific tech recipes for workbenches, weapons, and vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/df5a527b20c656936e0f9e551245f4bb244d2405.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/dc5059db3b40a39019086bb4b4deb1ab8c9865ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43708539/a10e880f6603ab37448567f65d296840b97bc0c6.jpg[/img]

[h3]- Smarter, More Powerful Bosses:[/h3]

We’ve upgraded the AI and combat behavior of bosses, introducing higher difficulty challenges. New bosses like the Humble Clown, Claw Spider, and Mutant Troll each bring unique attack patterns and skills, making every battle a fresh and strategic challenge. Defeating these bosses will yield high-quality blueprints, encouraging players to keep pushing their limits.

This update is packed with features designed to provide a deeper, more immersive experience. We can’t wait for you to dive into Adventure Mode and explore all the new content.

Stay tuned for the update release this week, and gear up for your next big adventure in The Front!
